verses.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.

xrefs.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.

verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

xrefs.text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

verses.text: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.

xrefs.text: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.
You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
And I watched as the Lamb opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,

verses.text: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.

xrefs.text: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.

but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.

verses.text: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.

xrefs.text: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”

verses.text: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.

xrefs.text: “I will rise up against them,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will cut off from Babylon her name and her remnant, her offspring and her posterity,” declares the LORD.
But Moses told the people, “Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation, which He will accomplish for you today; for the Egyptians you see today, you will never see again.
The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.

verses.text: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.

xrefs.text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.

verses.text: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.

xrefs.text: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.
before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
But because of your hard and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.

verses.text: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

xrefs.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

verses.text: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

xrefs.text: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.

verses.text: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.

xrefs.text: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.

verses.text: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

xrefs.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.
And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man:

verses.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,

xrefs.text: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”

For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.

verses.text: that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.

xrefs.text: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
At that time Hannah prayed: “My heart rejoices in the LORD; my horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth speaks boldly against my enemies, for I rejoice in Your salvation.
May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.

verses.text: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

xrefs.text: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.
He who sows injustice will reap disaster, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

verses.text: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah

xrefs.text: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD, when I stretch out My hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out from among them.”
An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
When Israel saw the great power that the LORD had exercised over the Egyptians, the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses.
May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

Then Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table. As I have done to them, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.

verses.text: The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.

xrefs.text: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness, there will be wrath and anger.
and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.

verses.text: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.

xrefs.text: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
For surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off.
He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.

verses.text: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.

xrefs.text: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.

verses.text: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah

xrefs.text: But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.
I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
